"''Affirmative. We're standing by.|Howzer and Greer|}} '''Greer''' was a [[human]] [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]], created for service in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Grand Army of the Republic]]. By around [[18 BBY]], Greer had joined the [[Clone Underground]] movement which sought to liberate their [[Clone trooper|clone]] brethren from the [[Galactic Empire]]. Greer traveled to [[Pantora]] with [[Samson]], [[Howzer]], [[Nemec]], and [[Rex]] to help protect [[Senator]] [[Avi Singh]] during his [[Riyo Chuchi and Avi Singh's secret meeting|secret meeting]] with Senator [[Riyo Chuchi]] on [[Pantora]]. During the mission, Greer was choked unconscious by the Imperial [[Clone X trooper]] [[CX-1]]. ==Biography== Greer was created on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] as a [[Cloning|clone]] of the [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett]] to serve in the [[Galactic Republic]]'s [[Grand Army of the Republic|clone army]] during the [[Clone Wars]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]]. At some point during or before [[18 BBY]], Greer joined the [[Clone Underground]] resistance network. During that [[time]], Greer was deployed to the [[planet]] [[Pantora]] alongside [[Samson]], [[Howzer]], [[Nemec]], and [[Rex]] on a [[Riyo Chuchi and Avi Singh's secret meeting|mission]] to protect [[Senator]] [[Riyo Chuchi]] and Senator [[Avi Singh]] while they held a meeting regarding former Republic and Separatist worlds' growing discontent with [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] and the [[Galactic Empire|Empire]]. Greer was tasked with standing guard over the kitchen for [[Pantora tea parlor|the building]] where the meeting took place. While the meeting was in session, Imperial [[Clone X trooper]] [[CX-1]] was already on the planet, and had been stalking senator Singh while he was escorted to the building. The [[assassin]] entered the [[city]]'s maintenance tunnels, and made his way to underneath the building. The assassin exited the tunnels though a hatch located in a small room in the building's kitchen area, and opened the door leading outside the room. Standing outside the door was Greer, who the assassin subsequently attacked and choked unconscious. Outside the building, Howzer who was stationed on sentry duty outside asked both Samson and Greer for a status report. While Samson replied, Greer did not, and a concerned Howzer asked Rex to check the kitchen. Rex spotted the assassin intruder, and foiled his attempt to kill the senators. Both Rex and Nemec chased the assassin back into the maintenance tunnels, where they saw Greer's unconscious body laying on the floor. ==Equipment== Greer wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor]] with customized [[Color|green]] markings. Additionally, he adorned a [[blaster]] [[holster]] on his left leg, a pouch on his right leg and ankle, and a sheath on his left wrist. Greer wielded a [[Vibroknife|vibro-knife]], a [[DC-17 repeater hand blaster|DC-17 hand blaster]], and a [[DC-15A blaster carbine]]. ==Behind the scenes== Greer appeared in "[[Infiltration (episode)|Infiltration]]," the sixth episode of ''[[Star Wars: The Bad Batch]]''{{'s}} [[The Bad Batch Season 3|third season]], which premiered on [[March 13]], [[2024]] on [[Disney+]].{{SW|url=news/the-bad-batch-season-3-trailer|text=Watch the ''Star Wars: The Bad Batch'' Season 3 Trailer}} ==Appearances== *{{TBB|Infiltration (episode)}} {{1st}} ==Sources== *{{Databank|greer|Greer}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Greer |fr=Greer |ja=グリアー |ka=გრირი }} [[Category:Clone troopers]] [[Category:Clone Underground members]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]]
